chapter: Ringside orchestra and New Orleans players
title: Oscar Markwood on jazz fiddle and Emmett Hardy
summary: Oscar is the jazz fiddler in the picture; the interviewer relays that Oscar knew Emmett Hardy from across the river.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: That's a jazz fiddle. That's not no regular fiddle, no straight fiddle, that's a jazz fiddle.
Oh yeah, I knew him. Well he ought to tell you he knew me too. Yeah, well.
Oscar and I don't know, no friends.
He told me he's from across the river and he knew a guy named Emmett Hardy over there. Emmett Hardy, sure. Did you know Emmett? Oh yeah.
He knew Emmett when he was trying to learn how to make a note on the horn.
Oh. Was he good? He developed pretty good.
